Aliph_Khān
father of Daulatkhān (a. of Daulatvinodasāra. med. Bikaner 4065).

Alimandāra
--Mahāviṣṇupūjāpaddhati. Sūcīpattra 42. a. name mistake for Ālavandār or Yāmuna; however a work of the above name is not known among his productions.

Alimanmathasādhana
Bud. by Padmākara. Cordier II. p. 379.

Alimanmathasādhana
Bud. Ratnāṅkura. Cordier III. p. 33. Nepal II. p.. 265 ff.
Pt.. in Sādhanamālā, Vol. I. GOS. XXVI. no. 73.

Alivilāsisaṃlāpa
khaṇḍakāvya. by Gaṅgādhara Śāstrin. Pt.. Benares, 1907. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 76.

Āliga
a Nāgara Brahman of Dholkā, father of Cāṇḍūpaṇḍita (Naiṣadhīya Dīpikā 1456) an. Tālhaṇa. See BORI. D. XIII. i. p.. 482, 483.

Āliṅganadānapaddhati
on the embracing of a healthy person by one on sick bed an. presenting him with images of himself an. [Page183-b] his disease, for getting rid of the disease; a. set forth in Rudrayāmala. Burnell 150a. TD. 13768.

Ālicatuṣṭaya
Bud. by Kānhapāda. Cordier II. p. 38.
--C. by a. Ibid. p. 38.
